body:
User asked (verbatim):
  - Deferred I44: a visibility setting on presigned uploads, which is a core security design decision.
  - Partial or kept items: 17, each with its reason in the internal audit notes.
  do all and also floowl up too   Docs follow-up: 31 newer features have a guide but no runnable example yet.

Decisions: security floors stay (C6 link lifetime cap, I7 token entropy, C13 SVG allowlist, I12 trash counts toward quota, GPS never kept in I50). Everything else implemented opt-in with today as default. Nothing is tagged yet, so a breaking change is allowed where needed (I21, I26) and is tagged [breaking] in CHANGELOG.

Acceptance: I44, I32, I31 per-call, I21, I6 deny, B5 success shapes, I18, I19, I13, I26, I50 EXIF copyright, I51 HLS, C12 oEmbed, I49 ranges done or reported with a hard blocker; 31 features get runnable examples; gates green; ask before commit.
title: No-hardwire round 3: I44 and the deferred items, plus runnable examples for 31 features
